description: Why events never reached Sentry. Answers 'I called captureException but the event isn't in Sentry' — the single most common Sentry problem — by naming the layer that discarded it: a beforeSend callback returning null, a sample-rate roll, dedupe or another event processor, React Native tracing discarding an empty transaction, or a native rate limit.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.
